items.title: Salmon raises funds to double down in the Philippines
items.snippet: Philippines-based banking and lending platform Salmon Group has raised $90 million in financing and another $50 million of bond proceeds.

items.title: Stifel invests in Meow; preps white label treasury platform
items.snippet: Stifel Financial has led a $31.6 million Series B finding round for business banking fintech Meow Technologies. The investment is part of a wider deal that will also see Stifel Bank offer a white-label version of Meow’s treasury management platform to its commercial banking clients.
